plugin.name: OCum Ascended synchronization
plugin.description: Synchronizes OCum Ascended CumOverlays and its vaginal/anal OStim equip-object meshes between Skyrim Together players. v0.37.1 keeps OCum/RaceMenu exclusively authoritative for the real local player's rendering and mirrors that live visibility remotely. When an owner-visible Body overlay reaches an STR proxy, OStim Together now requests RaceMenu's Add-only overlay rebuild: RaceMenu reinstalls Body [OvlN] against the proxy's current body/skin and reapplies the stored owner overrides, without the holder-removal race of the old Remove+Add path. Requires OCum Ascended on both clients.

plugin.name: PPA - Procedural Penis Animations synchronization
plugin.description: Synchronizes PPA runtime penetration targets between Skyrim Together scene participants, including per-stage target site and explicit target actor in multi-actor scenes. v0.33.3+ also reproduces PPA's native active-runtime refresh after remote target writes. Recommended by default and still user-deselectable. If PPA is not installed or the runtime DLL is unsupported, OStim Together disables this optional integration safely. Requires PPA on both clients for synchronization.
